gloss: to chirp; to twitter; to warble

definitions.gloss: to chirp; to twitter; to warble
definitions.explanation: The melodic singing or chirping of birds, especially small songbirds.
To talk rapidly and continuously, often about trivial matters (sometimes mildly derogatory).

examples.japanese: {小鳥|ことり}がさえずっている。
{春|はる}になると{鳥|とり}のさえずりが{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: When spring comes, you can hear birds singing.

examples.japanese: {女の子|おんなのこ}たちが{楽|たの}しそうにさえずっていた。
examples.english: The girls were chattering away happily.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). No pair verb.

KANJI:
Can be written as {囀|さえず}る, though hiragana is more common.

USAGE:
Primarily used for the melodic singing of small birds. When used for people (sense 2), it often has a slightly dismissive nuance, comparing chatter to bird sounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{鳥|とり}がさえずる (birds chirp)
・{小鳥|ことり}がさえずる (small birds sing)
・さえずりを{聞|き}く (to listen to birdsong)
・さえずりの{声|こえ} (chirping voice)

RELATED NOUN:
さえずり - chirping, birdsong, twitter
・{鳥|とり}のさえずり (bird's song)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{鳴|な}く - to cry/call (general animal sounds)
・{歌|うた}う - to sing (for people, or poetically for birds)
・ちゅんちゅん - chirp chirp (onomatopoeia for sparrows)
